evidence: The organometallic molybdenum precursor (Praxair, >99%) was vaporized in a stainless steel bubbler heated at 70 °C and its vapor was delivered into the reaction chamber with the use of argon (99.999% pure) as carrier gas. The mixture of N2 (99.999% pure) and H2 (99.999% pure) with a ratio of 1 to 2 was delivered into the reaction chamber through a separate delivery line. Ar was also used after each Mo precursor and co-reactant pulses to remove excess reactants inside the reaction chamber.
